text:
oliver: Day 1 quick ask  Who do I ping for VPC peering, private deploy permissions, and who signs off on canary QA? Trying to make a 1-line cheatsheet.

tara: Welcome! Short map: eng-infra = VPC & low-level creds; eng-platform = private deploy flow & gating; eng-runtime (runtime lead) + product = canary QA/approvals.

sam: Add-on: people-ops does baseline account provisioning. After that, for urgent canary failures page #eng-oncall and tag @eng-sre + @eng-runtime. For regular rollout help open the "rollout-help" ticket.

infra-bot: Note: eng-infra office hours Wed 14:00 PT. For peering requests use label "vpc-urgent" on the infra tracker.

oliver: Awesome, thanks. Can you give a short copyable snippet I can keep in my notes?

tara: Sure, copy this:

```
Who-to-ping (quick):
- VPC / peering: @eng-infra (file vpc ticket)
- Private deploys: @eng-platform
- Canary QA / rollout approvals: @eng-runtime + @product
- P1 (service down): page #eng-oncall + @eng-sre + runtime lead
- Onboarding / baseline creds: @people-ops
```

sam: I'll DM you the runbook link and add you to the onboarding contacts sheet. Ping if anything is missing.

oliver: Perfect  saving this now :thumbsup:
